```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(billboard)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarize(
    earliest_date = min(date.entered),
    latest_date = max(date.entered)
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "week", values_to = "ranking") |>
  summarize(
    missing = sum(is.na(ranking)),
    present = sum(!is.na(ranking)),
    .by = week
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    wk1:wk76,
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

ggplot(
  billboard_long,
  aes(week, rank, group = interaction(artist, track))
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse()

billboard_long |>
  summarize(last_week = max(week), .by = c(artist, track)) |>
  filter(last_week == 20) |>
  left_join(
    billboard_long |> filter(week == 20),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  summarize(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50)
  ) |>
  print()

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_best_week = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  )

number_one_songs <- song_summary |> filter(best_rank == 1)
top_10_songs <- song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  number_one_songs |>
    slice_min(first_best_week, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to number one"),
  number_one_songs |>
    slice_max(first_best_week, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    slice_max(weeks_on_chart, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest chart run among top 10")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_best_week, weeks_on_chart)

print(song_summary)
print(notable_songs)
```
